# Task Monitor — Feature Research (Phase 1)

_Benchmarked against Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Motion_

**Date:** 2026-09-20 · **App type:** Personal PM suite; kanban+Gantt+time log, local Claude CLI as the AI brain · **Benchmarks:** Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Motion · **Generated by:** claude-cli

## 1. Competitive set

| Brand | Core identity | What it's best at | Weakness we exploit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Linear | Keyboard-first issue tracker for software teams; cycles, triage, projects, roadmaps; opinionated minimal UI with sub-100ms feel. | Speed, keyboard shortcuts, clean defaults, cycle/velocity views, GitHub-native workflow. | No time logging, no per-day activity ledger, no calendar drag-to-reschedule, AI is cloud-only and opaque, and it is built for engineering teams rather than a single owner running mixed personal and client projects. We exploit: hours-per-day ledger, plan-vs-actual honesty, local AI that never leaves the machine. |
| Asana | Work-management platform for cross-functional teams; list/board/timeline/calendar, portfolios, workload, rules automation. | Multi-view parity (one task, many views), dependencies, workload/capacity, portfolio roll-ups, rules engine. | Timeline and workload are gated behind paid tiers, timesheets are third-party, AI Intelligence is a black box with no degraded signal, and there is no real free single-owner setup. We exploit: every view free and local, native hours log, transparent AI status. |
| Monday.com | Colorful spreadsheet-like Work OS with boards, columns, automations, dashboards, and a large template marketplace. | Visual dashboards, status-color columns, recipe automations, templates for every industry. | Board-column model buries plan-vs-actual and dependencies behind add-on columns, Gantt and time tracking require Pro, and heavy per-seat pricing punishes a one-owner-plus-invitees team. We exploit: native Gantt with arrows and resizable plan bars, time log as a first-class object, no per-seat cost. |
| ClickUp | Everything-app: tasks, docs, whiteboards, goals, time tracking, 15+ views, ClickUp Brain AI. | Feature breadth, native time tracking with timesheets, custom fields, recurring tasks, Gantt with critical path. | Overwhelming UI, slow loads, settings sprawl, recurring-task edge cases confuse users, AI is metered and cloud-only. We exploit: a small, fast surface with only the views that matter, idempotent recurrence, AI that runs locally on the owner's CLI with visible cost and degraded state. |
| Notion | Flexible docs-plus-databases workspace; board, timeline, calendar and table are views over one database; Notion AI for drafting. | Free-form documents, templates, database relations, personal-to-team scaling, AI writing inside pages. | Timeline lacks true dependency scheduling and resize-with-duration, no hours logging, no due alerts with quiet hours, offline is weak, and AI drafting has no grounding in the user's own research notebooks. We exploit: real Gantt with dependencies, per-day hours, quiet-hour alerts, NotebookLM-grounded drafts. |
| Motion | AI auto-scheduler that places tasks into calendar slots based on priority, deadline and availability; task manager plus calendar plus meeting booking. | Automatic time-blocking, deadline risk warnings, calendar integration, one-person productivity. | Opaque scheduling that reshuffles without explanation, no Gantt with dependencies, no kanban worth using, no activity/hours ledger, no team roles, cloud-only AI with no degraded signal. We exploit: explainable AI suggestions the owner accepts or rejects, plan-vs-actual history, real kanban and Gantt, workspace roles enforced in rules. |

## 2. Full feature inventory

71 features. "Our version" states what Task Monitor modifies or improves — parity plus a clear improvement, never "same as X". MVP rows go into the v0.1 starter.

| Area | Feature | Sub-features | Benefit to user | Who has it | Our version | MVP |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Foundation | Workspace model with member roles | owner/admin/editor/viewer; members[] + acl{} per workspace and per project; invite by email or link; leave workspace | One owner controls who sees and edits what without a server. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Roles enforced in firestore.rules, not UI; per-project acl overrides workspace role; invite links carry workspace id in the URL hash (?ws=) so no router is needed. | v0.1 |
| Foundation | Anonymous-first auth with Google linking | Firebase Anonymous on first load; Google sign-in links the anonymous uid and keeps data; sign-out re-signs anonymously; device label | Zero-friction start, no data loss when upgrading to a real account. | Notion | linkWithPopup merges the anonymous account; on collision we migrate workspace membership to the Google uid via a batched write and keep the app usable after sign-out by immediately re-signing anonymously. | v0.1 |
| Foundation | Workspace isolation rules | every doc carries workspaceId; rules deny cross-workspace reads/writes; no new collection without a rule; rules unit tests | Client bugs cannot leak one team's tasks to another. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Motion | Isolation lives in firestore.rules with an emulator test suite run by npm test; UI never trusts its own filters. | v0.1 |
| Foundation | Soft delete and archive everywhere | deletedAt + deletedBy; archive project; trash view with restore; activities keep referencing task ids | Nothing is ever lost; audit trail stays intact. | Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Monday.com | Hard delete is impossible by rule (update-only, deletedAt allowed); trash view groups by project and restores subtasks and activities together. | v0.1 |
| Foundation | Hash routing and deep links | #/board/project?ws=; #/gantt; #/calendar/2026-09; #/task/<id>; back/forward works | Shareable URLs with no router library. | Linear, Asana, ClickUp, Notion | A 60-line hash parser; every view and filter is a URL; copying a link from any modal opens the same task on another device. | v0.1 |
| Foundation | Responsive shell with collapsible sidebar | collapses under 720px; icon rail; keyboard toggle; remembered per device | Usable on a laptop half-screen or a phone. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Motion | Plain CSS with --c-/--s-/--r- tokens; sidebar state is per-device localStorage and never a shared doc. | v0.1 |
| Foundation | Dark mode with design tokens | system-follow; manual override; per-device; all colors via tokens | Comfortable late-night use; consistent theming. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Motion | No UI library; a single tokens.css switches on [data-theme] so Gantt SVG arrows and calendar cells also re-theme. | v0.1 |
| Foundation | Category icons for projects and task types | icon picker per project; icon per task type (bug/feature/chore/meeting); color + icon shown on board cards and Gantt groups | Fast visual scanning across mixed personal and client projects. | Notion, ClickUp, Monday.com | A curated 48-icon SVG set (inline, themed by tokens), assigned per project group and task category; icons render in kanban, Gantt row headers and calendar chips. | v0.1 |
| Tasks | Quick create (Grok-style single box) | one input on every view; natural language: 'Fix login bug fri 3h @Lens'; parse project, dates, hours, priority; confirm chips before save; Cmd+K | Capture a task in two seconds without a form. | Linear, Motion, ClickUp, Asana | Local parser first (no AI needed), optional askAIJson enrichment marked degraded if the bridge is down; parsed fields show as editable chips, never JSON. | v0.1 |
| Tasks | Task CRUD with plan and actual dates | plan.startDate/endDate; actual.startDate/endDate; priority; status; assignee; estimate hours | Every task records what was planned and what happened. | ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com | Actual dates auto-fill on first In Progress move and on Done, editable afterward; all dates are YYYY-MM-DD local strings so the same task shows the same day on any device. | v0.1 |
| Tasks | Overdue, done-early, done-late indicators | badge on card; days variance; color by severity; filter by variance | Instant honesty about slippage. | ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com | Computed client-side from plan vs actual, shown as '+3d late' or '-2d early' chips on kanban, Gantt bar caps and calendar; done-early is celebrated, not hidden. | v0.1 |
| Tasks | Subtasks with progress roll-up | checklist inside task; percent complete on card; reset on recurrence; convert subtask to task | Break work down without cluttering the board. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Subtasks are an embedded array, not separate docs, so one write updates them and recurrence can reset them atomically. | v0.1 |
| Tasks | Task detail panel | slide-over on any view; tabs: details / activity / attachments / AI; keyboard nav between tasks | Edit without losing board context. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Motion | Same panel component in board, Gantt and calendar; opening writes #/task/<id> so the URL is shareable. | v0.1 |
| Tasks | Labels and tags | workspace-level labels; color; multi-select filter; label groups | Cross-project slicing. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Labels are an array on the task, workspace-scoped; filter state lives in the URL hash so a filtered board is a link. | later |
| Tasks | Priority levels | P0-P3; icon; sort; AI suggestion | Clear ordering under pressure. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Motion | Four levels with icons; the AI 'suggest priority' action explains its reasoning in one sentence and is marked degraded if not from the CLI. | later |
| Tasks | Custom fields | text/number/select/date/url; per project; shown on cards | Track client-specific data. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Field definitions on the project doc, values in task.custom{}; limited to five types to keep rules simple and exports flat. | later |
| Tasks | Bulk actions | multi-select; move status; shift dates by N days; assign; archive | Re-plan a week in one gesture. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp | Shift-dates bulk action moves plan bars while keeping durations, written as one batch (<=500 ops) with a single undo toast. | later |
| Tasks | Undo for destructive or move actions | toast with undo; 10-second window; covers drag, archive, bulk | Fearless drag-and-drop. | Linear, Asana, Notion | Undo replays the inverse patch through the same batched writer, so counters stay correct. | later |
| Kanban | Kanban board with drag-drop | To Do / In Progress / Done; dnd-kit pointer + keyboard sensors; order persisted; live sync via onSnapshot | The daily driver view. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Optimistic move with rollback on rule denial; a move to Done stamps actual.endDate and triggers recurrence; other devices see the card slide within a second. | v0.1 |
| Kanban | Swimlanes and grouping | group by project / assignee / priority; collapse lane; WIP count per column | See one owner's load across clients. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Swimlane choice is per-device and in the URL; WIP count turns amber when In Progress exceeds a per-device limit. | later |
| Kanban | Card compact/detailed density | show hours logged; show variance chip; show subtasks bar | Fit more on a small screen. | Linear, ClickUp, Notion | Density toggle per device; cards show totalHoursLogged and lastActivityAt from counters, no extra reads. | later |
| Gantt | Gantt with draggable/resizable plan bars | day/week/month zoom; drag bar to move; resize edges; today line; grouped by project | Plan visually. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Plan bar and actual bar render as two layers on one row so slippage is visible at a glance; drag writes YYYY-MM-DD strings only. | v0.1 |
| Gantt | SVG dependency arrows | finish-to-start; draw by dragging handle; cycle detection; highlight blocked tasks | Know what unblocks what. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp | Arrows are pure SVG themed by tokens; when a predecessor slips, dependents get a 'pushed' badge and an optional one-click shift. | v0.1 |
| Gantt | Critical path | longest chain highlight; slack display | Focus on what truly moves the end date. | ClickUp, Monday.com | Computed client-side from dependencies and plan durations, toggled per device, no extra data model. | later |
| Gantt | Milestones | zero-duration diamond; project-level; in calendar too | Mark deadlines that matter. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp | A task with type=milestone renders as a diamond in Gantt and a pinned chip in the calendar; overdue milestones pulse. | later |
| Gantt | Baseline snapshots | freeze plan dates; compare current vs baseline; named baselines | Prove how the plan drifted. | ClickUp, Monday.com | Baselines are stored on the project doc as an array of {name, date, tasks:{id:{start,end}}} and rendered as ghost bars. | later |
| Calendar | Month grid with drag to reschedule | drag chip to another day shifts plan.endDate; duration preserved; multi-day spans; today highlight | Re-plan by feel. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Motion | Drag preserves duration by moving both plan dates; dropping on a weekend prompts 'shift to Monday?' per a per-device work-week setting. | v0.1 |
| Calendar | Week and day views | hours logged per day; capacity bar; drag between days | See load, not just dates. | ClickUp, Motion, Notion | Day cells show hoursSpent sum from the activity ledger against a per-device daily capacity, coloring over-capacity days. | later |
| Calendar | ICS export and subscription URL | download .ics; per project or workspace | Tasks appear in Google/Apple Calendar. | Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Motion | Client-generated .ics named tasks-YYYY-MM-DD.ics; no server means no live feed, so the file includes a 'regenerate' reminder. | later |
| Time and Activity | Per-day activity log | comment; hoursSpent; completion status; bottleneck remarks; attachment URLs; one entry per task per day per user | A daily ledger of what happened and why it stalled. | ClickUp | Activity is its own collection keyed by task+date+user so a day-in-review can be built with one query; bottleneck remarks feed the AI standup draft. | v0.1 |
| Time and Activity | Task counters via batched increments | activityCount; totalHoursLogged; attachmentCount; lastActivityAt | Cards show totals with zero extra reads. | ClickUp, Asana | Every activity write is a batch that also increments the task doc; edits apply deltas; rules validate increments so a client cannot forge totals. | v0.1 |
| Time and Activity | Timer start/stop | running timer per device; auto-writes hoursSpent to today's entry; idle detection | Capture hours without arithmetic. | ClickUp, Monday.com | Timer state is per-device localStorage; on stop it merges into the task+date activity entry rather than creating a new row. | later |
| Time and Activity | Timesheet view | week grid task x day; totals; edit cells inline; export .xlsx | Bill clients and see weekly load. | ClickUp, Monday.com, Asana | Built from the activity ledger; exports timesheet-YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx with per-project subtotals and bottleneck notes column. | later |
| Time and Activity | Bottleneck register | list of all bottleneck remarks; group by task/project; mark resolved | Recurring blockers become visible patterns. | — | Unique: a view over activity entries with non-empty bottleneck text, with an AI 'find patterns' summary marked degraded if not fresh. | later |
| Time and Activity | Attachments as URLs only | Drive/Storage/any URL; title + favicon; attachmentCount | No storage costs, no upload pipeline. | Notion | Paste a URL, we fetch nothing server-side; type inferred from extension/host; opens in new tab; count kept on the task. | v0.1 |
| Recurrence and Templates | Recurring tasks | daily/weekly/monthly/custom N; spawn next on done; dates shifted by original duration; subtasks reset; idempotent per recurrenceParentId | Habits and retainers never fall off. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Motion | Next instance id is deterministic (parentId + occurrence index) so a double-click or two devices cannot spawn twice; end conditions by count or date. | v0.1 |
| Recurrence and Templates | Task and project templates | save from existing; payload without ids/dates/counters; apply with relative dates; template gallery with icons | Onboard a new client in one click. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Templates store day offsets from a chosen start date; applying asks only for a start date and project, never shows the payload. | v0.1 |
| Alerts | Due-task alerts | one task at a time; snooze/skip/mute; quiet hours; per-device only; service worker notification | Nudges without spam. | Asana, ClickUp, Motion, Monday.com | Alert queue is computed from shared tasks but snooze/skip/mute never touch the task doc; quiet hours are per-device; the alert card has Log Hours inline. | v0.1 |
| Alerts | In-app notification center | assigned to you; dependency unblocked; comment mention; mark read per device | Catch up after a day away. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Derived from a lightweight events collection per workspace; read-state per device; no email, no SMTP. | later |
| Alerts | Daily plan reminder | morning summary notification; evening 'log your hours' nudge | Builds the logging habit. | Motion, ClickUp | Service worker schedules two per-device notifications; the evening nudge opens the day-in-review with unlogged In Progress tasks pre-listed. | later |
| AI | Single AI chokepoint (askAI/askAIJson) | only bridge/ai.mjs spawns claude; --safe-mode --strict-mcp-config --tools ''; 127.0.0.1 bind; origin allowlist; timeout | Predictable cost, no data leaving the machine, no tool execution. | — | Unique: the AI brain is the owner's local Claude CLI, spawned hermetically; components cannot import anything but askAI/askAIJson (lint rule). | v0.1 |
| AI | AI status and degraded rendering | useAiStatus(); degraded + reason banner; denied tool = degraded; fallback never looks clean | Users always know when an answer is not the real thing. | — | Unique: every AI result carries {degraded, reason}; UI renders a striped border and reason text; never gated on an API key. | v0.1 |
| AI | AI task drafting | draft description; suggest subtasks; suggest estimate; suggest priority | Faster, better-specified tasks. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Motion | Runs through askAIJson with a strict schema; user sees editable fields, never JSON; each suggestion has Accept/Discard and a degraded marker. | v0.1 |
| AI | AI daily standup / day-in-review | from activity entries; yesterday/today/blockers; copy or export .md | Standup written in five seconds from real logs. | ClickUp, Notion | Grounded strictly in the day's activity ledger and bottleneck remarks; exports standup-YYYY-MM-DD.md. | later |
| AI | NotebookLM grounding | prepend cited notebook passages; citations shown; failed lookup still answers as degraded | Drafts reflect the owner's own research. | — | Unique: the bridge fetches notebook material, prepends it with citations; a lookup failure returns the plain answer with degraded reason 'notebook unavailable'. | v0.1 |
| AI | AI weekly report | hours by project; slippage summary; next-week plan; export .docx/.pdf | Client-ready update without writing. | Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Monday.com | Built from counters and variance, drafted locally, exported as weekly-report-YYYY-MM-DD.docx with degraded watermark if applicable. | later |
| AI | AI schedule suggestion (explainable) | propose plan dates for unscheduled tasks; respect dependencies and capacity; explain each move; accept/reject per task | Motion-like help without the reshuffle surprise. | Motion, ClickUp | Never auto-applies; shows a diff table of proposed date changes with one-line reasons; applies via the same batched shift-dates action. | later |
| AI | AI cost and token meter | per call tokens; daily total; per feature breakdown | Owner sees what the AI brain costs. | — | Unique: bridge returns usage with each call; a per-device panel charts tokens per day and per feature. | later |
| AI | AI comment summarizer | summarize long activity threads; extract decisions | Catch up on a stale task quickly. | Linear, Asana, ClickUp, Notion | Summary cached on the task with a hash of the inputs; stale summaries show as degraded 'outdated' until regenerated. | later |
| Collaboration | Comments on tasks | threaded; @mention; edit/soft-delete; markdown-lite | Discussion stays with the work. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Comments are a subcollection with workspaceId; mentions create an event for the notification center; no real-time co-editing. | later |
| Collaboration | Assignees and watchers | single assignee; watchers list; my tasks view | Clear ownership. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | My Tasks is a URL filter (#/board/mine); watchers receive events without email. | later |
| Collaboration | Presence indicators | who is viewing this task; last seen | Avoid stepping on each other. | Linear, Notion, Monday.com, ClickUp | Lightweight presence doc per user per workspace updated every 30s; shown as avatars on the task panel; no cursors. | later |
| Collaboration | Project overview page | description; members; progress ring; hours logged; upcoming milestones; recent activity | Landing page per project. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Aggregates from task counters so it renders with one project query plus one tasks query; exports overview-YYYY-MM-DD.pdf. | later |
| Reports and Exports | Export to files | .xlsx tasks and timesheet; .docx report; .pptx status deck; .md standup; .csv; .pdf; .html | Deliverables for clients and archives. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | All client-side (SheetJS, docx, pptxgenjs, jsPDF); every file named <name>-YYYY-MM-DD.<ext>; export dialog is plain toggles, no config text. | v0.1 |
| Reports and Exports | Dashboard widgets | tasks by status; hours per project; variance histogram; burndown | One glance at health. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Computed from in-memory task and activity snapshots; widgets are plain SVG themed by tokens; layout per device. | later |
| Reports and Exports | Import from CSV | column mapping UI; preview; dry run | Migrate from Asana/ClickUp exports. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Mapping via dropdowns; dates normalized to YYYY-MM-DD; imported in batches of 400 with progress and undo. | later |
| Reports and Exports | Workspace backup and restore | download full JSON bundle; restore into new workspace | Own your data without a server. | Notion, ClickUp | backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json is hidden behind a 'Download backup' button; user never sees JSON; restore remaps ids and workspaceId. | later |
| Search and Navigation | Global search | tasks, projects, activities, comments; fuzzy; keyboard-driven; recent items | Find anything in one box. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion, Motion | Client-side index over the live snapshot (workspace-scoped), so search works offline and needs no search service. | later |
| Search and Navigation | Saved views and filters | save current URL as a named view; pin to sidebar; per device or shared | Return to 'Client X this week' instantly. | Linear, Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | A saved view is literally a stored hash URL; shared views live on the workspace doc, private ones per device. | later |
| Search and Navigation | Keyboard shortcuts | c create; / search; 1-4 switch views; j/k move; ? help sheet | Linear-grade speed. | Linear, Asana, ClickUp, Notion | Shortcut sheet rendered from one registry; dnd-kit keyboard sensor makes board moves fully keyboard-accessible. | later |
| Reliability | Offline persistence and live sync | Firestore IndexedDB cache; pending-writes indicator; conflict handling by last write | Works on a train, syncs later. | Linear, Notion, ClickUp | Offline is first-class because there is no server: a status pill shows 'N changes pending' and AI actions render degraded 'offline' instead of failing silently. | later |
| Reliability | Test suite without external processes | node --test; no claude/notebooklm spawn; rules emulator tests; date helpers | Safe refactors. | — | Unique as a product promise: npm test is hermetic; AI bridge is mocked at the askAI boundary. | v0.1 |
| Reliability | One-command local run | npm install; npm run dev starts Vite + bridge; VS Code tasks.json | Any MacBook is a workstation. | — | Unique: dev script starts static client and the 127.0.0.1 AI bridge together; no cloud deploy needed to work. | v0.1 |
| Unique | Plan-vs-actual overlay history | actual bar under plan bar; variance timeline per project; slippage trend chart | Learn your own estimation bias. | — | Unique: every task stores both date pairs; a per-project chart shows average late-days over time and the AI names the pattern. | later |
| Unique | Day-in-review | all tasks touched today; hours sum; unlogged In Progress tasks; one-click log for each | Close the day with a complete ledger. | — | Unique: a single-date view over the activity collection with inline hour entry; feeds the standup draft. | later |
| Unique | Per-device preference vault | alerts, quiet hours, density, theme, capacity, timer; export/import preferences | Shared tasks stay clean; personal settings stay personal. | — | Unique as an explicit boundary: a prefs module with a schema; nothing in it is ever written to Firestore task docs. | later |
| Unique | Dependency slip propagation | detect predecessor slip; propose shifts for dependents; apply as batch | One late task does not silently break the plan. | ClickUp, Asana | Proposal-first, never automatic; shown as a diff with day counts; applied through the same batched writer with undo. | later |
| Unique | Status deck generator | project summary slides; Gantt snapshot image; hours table; .pptx | Client meeting deck in one click. | — | Unique: renders Gantt SVG to PNG and builds status-deck-YYYY-MM-DD.pptx locally; AI narration slide marked degraded if applicable. | later |
| Unique | Estimate accuracy coaching | estimate vs hours logged per task; per-category bias; suggested multiplier | Better plans next month. | — | Unique: uses estimate hours and totalHoursLogged; suggests 'your bugs take 1.6x' and offers to apply to new estimates. | later |
| Unique | Workspace guest read-only share link | viewer role via link; project scope; revoke | Clients see progress without an account dance. | Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion | Link grants viewer acl to an anonymous uid after they open it; revocation removes the uid; no public unauthenticated reads. | later |
| Unique | Retainer hour budgets | monthly hour budget per project; burn bar; alert at 80% | Never overspend a client retainer. | — | Unique: budget on the project doc, burn computed from activity hoursSpent in the current month; alert is per-device. | later |

## 4. What makes us different — the four pillars

**Honest Plans.** Every task carries plan and actual dates, hours and bottlenecks, so the suite tells the truth about slippage and teaches the owner to estimate better.

- Features: Task CRUD with plan and actual dates, Overdue, done-early, done-late indicators, Per-day activity log, Task counters via batched increments, Bottleneck register, Plan-vs-actual overlay history, Estimate accuracy coaching, Baseline snapshots, Retainer hour budgets, Day-in-review, Timesheet view, Timer start/stop

**Three Views, One Task.** Kanban, Gantt and calendar are three surfaces over the same Firestore document; a drag anywhere writes the same YYYY-MM-DD fields and syncs live to every device.

- Features: Kanban board with drag-drop, Gantt with draggable/resizable plan bars, SVG dependency arrows, Month grid with drag to reschedule, Week and day views, Critical path, Milestones, Dependency slip propagation, Swimlanes and grouping, Subtasks with progress roll-up, Recurring tasks, Task and project templates, Quick create (Grok-style single box), Bulk actions, Undo for destructive or move actions

**Local, Honest AI.** The AI brain is the owner's own Claude CLI, spawned hermetically on 127.0.0.1 through one chokepoint; anything less than a real answer is shown as degraded with a reason.

- Features: Single AI chokepoint (askAI/askAIJson), AI status and degraded rendering, AI task drafting, NotebookLM grounding, AI daily standup / day-in-review, AI weekly report, AI schedule suggestion (explainable), AI cost and token meter, AI comment summarizer

**Serverless Trust.** Firestore plus static hosting is the whole backend; roles, isolation and soft delete are enforced in rules; personal preferences never touch shared docs; everything runs locally with one command and exports date-stamped files.

- Features: Workspace model with member roles, Anonymous-first auth with Google linking, Workspace isolation rules, Soft delete and archive everywhere, Hash routing and deep links, Responsive shell with collapsible sidebar, Dark mode with design tokens, Category icons for projects and task types, Due-task alerts, Per-device preference vault, Export to files, Status deck generator, Offline persistence and live sync, Test suite without external processes, One-command local run, Workspace backup and restore, Workspace guest read-only share link

## 6. Assumptions & open questions

1. The STACK line in the brief (Vite + Express + SQLite) is stale; the binding constraints win: React 19 + Vite + TypeScript client, Firestore + static Firebase Hosting, and bridge/ai.mjs as the only local process, running on 127.0.0.1 during development.
2. v0.1 targets one owner (Ace) plus up to ten invited members per workspace; per-seat pricing is not a concern.
3. All date-only fields are YYYY-MM-DD strings computed in Asia/Manila local time; timestamps (lastActivityAt) are Firestore Timestamps.
4. Kanban columns are fixed at To Do / In Progress / Done for v0.1; custom columns are post-MVP.
5. Dependencies are finish-to-start only in v0.1; other link types are post-MVP.
6. One activity entry per task per date per user; editing merges into that entry and applies counter deltas.
7. Recurrence instance ids are deterministic (recurrenceParentId + occurrence index) to guarantee idempotency across devices.
8. Attachments are URLs only; no bytes are ever uploaded by the app.
9. Exports are generated client-side with SheetJS, docx, pptxgenjs and jsPDF; the Node bridge does no file work.
10. Notifications use the service worker and in-app surfaces only; no email or SMTP ever.
11. Per-device preferences (theme, density, alerts, quiet hours, timer, capacity) live in localStorage under a versioned schema and never in Firestore task docs.
12. AI gating uses useAiStatus() only; there is no API-key concept in the UI.
13. Real-time collaborative text editing, custom kanban columns, and public unauthenticated share pages are out of scope for v0.x.
14. Benchmark feature claims reflect public product pages and documentation as of September 2026; tier gating may shift.

> Standing requirements applied: (1) Non-savvy users must never see JSON, {{templates}} or code — inputs are plain-language text fields, dropdowns and toggles. (2) Every button and every "succeeding" action behind it must work end-to-end; no dead UI. (3) The app must be able to generate output files (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx, .md, .txt, .html, .pdf) where relevant. (4) Icons per group/category; a Grok-like "quick create" path for the main object of the app. (5) Runs locally on a MacBook via VS Code with one install command and one run command. (6) Every deliverable file is date-stamped in its name: <name>-YYYY-MM-DD.<ext>.
